name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: AI & Automation Success Leader | Agentic AI, Client Strategy & Value Realization

Translates non-technical stakeholder goals into precise AI/automation logic, evaluates new tools directly, and owns account health end to end, from onboarding through renewal and expansion. Comfortable operating deep in a technical environment (SQL, Power BI, agent workflow design) without being an engineer.

Design self-improving evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs, and personally perform data labeling and rubric-based grading to keep automated systems accurate.

Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of clients, evaluating and piloting new automation and AI tools (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, n8n) and identifying opportunities to expand engagement scope.

Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, analyzing utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
